name: Design and Development of Advanced Intelligent Computing Systems 2
description: The course is an advanced DIY hands-on project activity based on the end to end development of an intelligent computing appliance, its software (including OS and user level applications), hardware design (enclosure, PCB, ruggedness testing) based on a COTS platform. The final prototype must be at TRL7 level and will be subjected to standard industry standards for software audit, compliance and acceptance testing.
